title: Send a client a photo gallery link

steps.caption: Pipeline
steps.narration: Send a client a link to their job's photos. Start by opening the job.

steps.caption: Open the job
steps.narration: On Pipeline, click the job's name.

steps.caption: Share
steps.narration: Choose Share. With no photos selected, it shares the job's live timeline.

steps.caption: Title
steps.narration: Give the link a title your client will recognise.

steps.caption: Password and expiry
steps.narration: You can add a password, and choose when the link expires.

steps.caption: The link
steps.narration: The link is ready to copy.

steps.caption: Send to
steps.narration: Or send it from here. Put in your client's email address.

steps.caption: The client opens the link
steps.narration: Now your client. They open the link from that email. There is nothing to sign in to.

steps.caption: The job and its photos
steps.narration: They see your company, the job, and its photos, newest first.

steps.caption: Back in the CRM
steps.narration: Back in the CRM, every link you made is listed under Existing links.

steps.caption: Revoke
steps.narration: To turn one off, choose Revoke.

steps.caption: The link is off
steps.narration: If your client opens it now, it says the link was turned off.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: You will find Share on every job's JobCam page.

youtube.title: How to send a client a link to their job photos | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Make a link to a job's photo timeline in ConstructHUB JobCam, email it to your client, see the page they open, and turn the link off again with Revoke. Recorded in a demo workspace; the photos are colour cards made for the demo.
